\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{index::doc}}


\sphinxAtStartPar
The Probabilistic Cataloger (PCAT) is a hierarchical, transdimensional Bayesian
inference framework for datasets whose number of sources or other model elements
is unknown. It samples an ensemble of catalogs rather than returning only one
best\sphinxhyphen{}fit catalog. The framework was introduced by \sphinxhref{https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-4357/aa679e}{Daylan, Portillo, and
Finkbeiner (2017)} in ApJ 839, 4.

\sphinxAtStartPar
PCAT supports simulated and supplied data, population\sphinxhyphen{}level priors, birth and
death proposals, posterior catalog summaries, convergence diagnostics, static
figures, and posterior animations. The maintained examples exercise the current
public workflow and are the best starting points for new analyses.

\sphinxstepscope


\chapter{Getting started}
\label{\detokenize{getting_started:getting-started}}\label{\detokenize{getting_started::doc}}

\section{Requirements}
\label{\detokenize{getting_started:requirements}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
PCAT requires Python 3.10 or newer. Its runtime dependencies are declared in
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pyproject.toml}} and include NumPy, SciPy, Astropy, Matplotlib, h5py, Numba,
Seaborn, and TDpy.

\sphinxAtStartPar
For development with sibling repositories, install TDpy and PCAT in editable
mode:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n+nb}{cd}\PYG{+w}{ }/path/to/tdpy
python\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}m\PYG{+w}{ }pip\PYG{+w}{ }install\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}e\PYG{+w}{ }.
\PYG{n+nb}{cd}\PYG{+w}{ }/path/to/pcat
python\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}m\PYG{+w}{ }pip\PYG{+w}{ }install\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}e\PYG{+w}{ }.
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Install the documentation dependencies with:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
python\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}m\PYG{+w}{ }pip\PYG{+w}{ }install\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}e\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}.[docs]\PYGZdq{}}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\section{First run}
\label{\detokenize{getting_started:first-run}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Run the compact Chandra\sphinxhyphen{}style demonstration from the repository root:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
python\PYG{+w}{ }examples/chan\PYGZus{}demo/generate\PYGZus{}demo.py
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The script uses {\hyperref[\detokenize{api:pcat.demo.run_pipeline_demo}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pcat.demo.run\_pipeline\_demo()}}}}} to supply plotting defaults
and calls {\hyperref[\detokenize{api:pcat.main.sample}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pcat.main.sample()}}}}}. Its source is intentionally short and is a
runnable configuration template.

\sphinxAtStartPar
A programmatic demonstration has the same form:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{pathlib}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Path}

\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{pcat}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{demo}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{run\PYGZus{}pipeline\PYGZus{}demo}

\PYG{n}{run\PYGZus{}pipeline\PYGZus{}demo}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Path}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{analysis/point\PYGZus{}sources}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{typeexpr}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{chan}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{typeelem}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{lghtpnts}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{truenumbelempop0}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{fittminmnumbelempop0}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{fittmaxmnumbelempop0}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{dicttrue}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{typeelemspateval}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{full}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{dictfitt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{typeelemspateval}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{full}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{numbsidecart}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{8}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{numbswep}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{numbsamp}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{numbswepplot}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{strgcnfg}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{point\PYGZus{}sources}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This configuration is a pipeline check, not a scientifically converged chain.
Production analyses require enough samples, convergence checks, and
problem\sphinxhyphen{}specific prior validation.


\section{Runtime paths}
\label{\detokenize{getting_started:runtime-paths}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pathbase}} is the root for one analysis and contains \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{data/}} and
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{visuals/}}. If \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pathbase}} is omitted, PCAT uses \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PCAT\_DATA\_PATH}} and then
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{TDGU\_DATA\_PATH}}. \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PCAT\_PATH}} separately identifies the repository root for
repository\sphinxhyphen{}local utilities and does not replace the analysis output path.


\section{Configuration principles}
\label{\detokenize{getting_started:configuration-principles}}\begin{itemize}
\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Set \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{typedata="simu"}} for generated data and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{typedata="inpt"}} for
supplied data.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use a filesystem\sphinxhyphen{}safe \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{strgcnfg}} run tag.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Set deterministic seeds for reproducible simulations and chains.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Keep true\sphinxhyphen{}model settings in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{dicttrue}} and fitted\sphinxhyphen{}model settings in
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{dictfitt}} when defaults would otherwise overwrite the intended model.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolmakeplotinit}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolmakeplotfram}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolmakeplotfinlpost}}, and
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{makeanim}} to control visual products.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Treat short smoke configurations as integration checks rather than evidence
for scientific claims.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxstepscope


\chapter{Maintained examples}
\label{\detokenize{examples:maintained-examples}}\label{\detokenize{examples::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Each example owns one subdirectory under \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{examples/}}. Source, generated data,
and visuals stay together so outputs can be traced to the configuration that
created them.


\section{Pipeline demonstrations}
\label{\detokenize{examples:pipeline-demonstrations}}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{chan\_demo}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Compact Chandra\sphinxhyphen{}style point\sphinxhyphen{}source detection with simulated data.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gmix\_demo}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Two\sphinxhyphen{}dimensional variable\sphinxhyphen{}width Gaussian\sphinxhyphen{}mixture inference with genuine
birth and death transitions.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{hst\_lens}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Hubble Space Telescope Wide Field Camera 3 lensing\sphinxhyphen{}style image inference.

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Run all maintained pipeline checks and verify their figures with:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
python\PYG{+w}{ }examples/run\PYGZus{}examples.py
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\section{Publication and instrument examples}
\label{\detokenize{examples:publication-and-instrument-examples}}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Daylan+2017}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Scaled mock\sphinxhyphen{}catalog reproduction of Daylan, Portillo, and Finkbeiner (2017).
The smoke mode preserves the inference pattern while reducing the source
count and chain length.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
python\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}examples/Daylan+2017/generate\PYGZus{}reproduction.py\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{}smoke\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{}fresh
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{voigt\sphinxhyphen{}profile}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Simulated nominal and high\sphinxhyphen{}signal Voigt\sphinxhyphen{}profile line detection.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
python\PYG{+w}{ }examples/voigt\PYGZhy{}profile/pcat\PYGZus{}voigt\PYGZus{}profile\PYGZus{}detection.py\PYG{+w}{ }\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{}configuration\PYG{+w}{ }nomi
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{roman\_lens\_catalog}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Seeded Roman strong\sphinxhyphen{}lens population benchmark and catalog\sphinxhyphen{}detection
diagnostic.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
python\PYG{+w}{ }examples/roman\PYGZus{}lens\PYGZus{}catalog/roman\PYGZus{}lens\PYGZus{}catalog\PYGZus{}diagnostic.py
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{fermi\_lat\_pg1553}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Fermi Large Area Telescope event\sphinxhyphen{}filter configuration for PG 1553+113. This
utility requires the Fermi Science Tools and local mission data.

\end{description}


\section{Scientific interpretation}
\label{\detokenize{examples:scientific-interpretation}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Generated examples are deterministic pipeline demonstrations unless their
README explicitly states otherwise. Synthetic outputs validate computation and
visualization but do not constitute measurements of real astrophysical systems.
The Daylan+2017 README distinguishes its maintained scaled simulation from the
archival Fermi\sphinxhyphen{}LAT analysis in the publication.

\sphinxstepscope


\chapter{Outputs and diagnostics}
\label{\detokenize{outputs:outputs-and-diagnostics}}\label{\detokenize{outputs::doc}}

\section{Directory layout}
\label{\detokenize{outputs:directory-layout}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A run with output root \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pathbase}} and tag \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{strgcnfg}} writes:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
pathbase/
|\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} data/
|   `\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} outp/
|       `\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} strgcnfg/
|           |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} cmndargs.txt
|           |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} stat.txt
|           |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} gdatinit.p
|           |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} gdatinit.h5
|           |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} gdatmodi0000post.p
|           |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} gdatmodi0000post.h5
|           |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} gdatfinlpost.p
|           `\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} gdatfinlpost.h5
`\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} visuals/
    `\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} strgcnfg/
        |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} init/
        `\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} post/
            |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} fram/
            |\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} finl/
            `\PYGZhy{}\PYGZhy{} anim/
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
When \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pathbase}} already ends in the run tag, PCAT avoids repeating that name
under \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{visuals/}}. For example, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{examples/gmix\_demo}} writes directly to
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{examples/gmix\_demo/visuals/init}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{visuals/post}}.


\section{State files}
\label{\detokenize{outputs:state-files}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatinit}} stores initialized configuration and model metadata.
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatmodi\#\#\#\#post}} stores worker\sphinxhyphen{}chain products. \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatfinlpost}} stores the
aggregated posterior state and derived summaries. PCAT splits each state between
a pickle file and an HDF5 companion, and {\hyperref[\detokenize{api:pcat.main.readfile}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pcat.main.readfile()}}}}} reconstructs
the object from the extension\sphinxhyphen{}free path:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{pathlib}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Path}

\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{pcat}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{main}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{readfile}

\PYG{n}{run\PYGZus{}root} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Path}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{examples/gmix\PYGZus{}demo}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{state} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{readfile}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n+nb}{str}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{run\PYGZus{}root} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{data}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{outp}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{gmix\PYGZus{}demo}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{gdatfinlpost}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{state}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{numbsamp}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\section{Completion markers}
\label{\detokenize{outputs:completion-markers}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{stat.txt}} is append\sphinxhyphen{}only and records completed stages. A fully processed run
normally contains \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatfinlpost written.}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{plotfinlpost written.}}, and,
when animations are enabled, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{animfinl written.}}. Validate the corresponding
files as well as the markers before treating a run as complete.


\section{Visual products}
\label{\detokenize{outputs:visual-products}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{init}} contains simulated data, reference\sphinxhyphen{}model, and initial diagnostics.
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{post/fram}} contains snapshots across the chain. \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{post/finl}} contains final
posterior summaries and diagnostics. \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{post/anim}} contains GIFs assembled from
frame plots. Empty optional directories are removed at successful completion.


\section{Convergence and interpretation}
\label{\detokenize{outputs:convergence-and-interpretation}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Inspect effective sample sizes, split\sphinxhyphen{}chain or multi\sphinxhyphen{}chain convergence metrics,
proposal acceptance, likelihood traces, model\sphinxhyphen{}count transitions, and posterior
predictive residuals. A completed process is not necessarily a converged or
scientifically adequate inference. Transdimensional parameters also require
population\sphinxhyphen{}level or association\sphinxhyphen{}aware summaries because raw element labels are
not persistent.


\section{Reproducibility checklist}
\label{\detokenize{outputs:reproducibility-checklist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Before publishing or comparing runs, preserve and report:
\begin{itemize}
\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
the PCAT and TDpy repository revisions and Python environment;

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{cmndargs.txt}} and all explicit random seeds;

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
input filenames, versions, selections, units, and checksums;

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatfinlpost.p}} and its matching \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatfinlpost.h5}} companion;

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
retained sample count, convergence thresholds, and measured diagnostics;

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
proposal acceptance and model\sphinxhyphen{}count transition summaries;

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
posterior predictive data, model, and residual plots; and

\item {} \begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{whether the run used real data, a controlled simulation, or a smoke\sphinxhyphen{}test}
\sphinxAtStartPar
configuration.

\end{description}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Do not compare serialized states copied without their HDF5 companions. Avoid
overwriting a completed run with a different configuration under the same run
tag; use a new \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{strgcnfg}} or remove both cached data and visuals deliberately.

\sphinxstepscope


\chapter{Troubleshooting}
\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting:troubleshooting}}\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting::doc}}

\section{Output path errors}
\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting:output-path-errors}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{No output data path is configured}} means neither \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pathbase}} nor a supported
environment variable was provided. Pass \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pathbase}} explicitly or set
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PCAT\_DATA\_PATH}}. \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PCAT\_PATH}} identifies the repository for local utilities
and does not select a sampler output directory.

\sphinxAtStartPar
If final processing or animation reports that \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PCAT\_DATA\_PATH}} is not set,
pass the same \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pathbase}} used for sampling. A run cannot be reconstructed from
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{visuals/}} alone because final processing reads serialized states under
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{data/outp/\textless{}run tag\textgreater{}/}}.


\section{Incomplete runs}
\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting:incomplete-runs}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Inspect \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{data/outp/\textless{}run tag\textgreater{}/stat.txt}} from bottom to top. A complete posterior
run normally records these stages in order:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
gdatinit written.
gdatmodipost written.
gdatfinlpost written.
plotfinlpost written.
animfinl written.
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The animation marker is expected only when animation generation is enabled.
Missing \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatinit}} indicates initialization did not finish. Missing
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatmodipost}} indicates a worker failed before writing its chain. Missing
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gdatfinlpost}} means worker products were not aggregated. Read the original
traceback before rerunning so a configuration defect is not hidden by cached
partial state.


\section{Stale caches}
\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting:stale-caches}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
PCAT can reuse existing state for a matching run tag. After changing model
structure, output paths, or plotting configuration, make a fresh run. Maintained
entry points that support it accept \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\sphinxhyphen{}\sphinxhyphen{}fresh}}. Otherwise remove both
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{data/outp/\textless{}run tag\textgreater{}}} and its corresponding visual run directory, preserving
any products needed for provenance first.


\section{Missing figures or animations}
\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting:missing-figures-or-animations}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Check \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolmakeplot}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolmakeplotinit}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolmakeplotfram}},
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolmakeplotfinlpost}}, and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{makeanim}}. Animations require at least two frame
plots, controlled by chain length and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{numbswepplot}}. Frames that are visually
identical may collapse to a single\sphinxhyphen{}frame GIF; such a file is a static image and
should not be reported as an animation.

\sphinxAtStartPar
For headless systems, set a writable Matplotlib cache before running:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\section{Sampling configuration failures}
\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting:sampling-configuration-failures}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Sampling failed due to incomplete or inconsistent model configuration}} wraps
a lower\sphinxhyphen{}level attribute, key, index, or type error. Preserve the chained
traceback and compare the configuration with the nearest maintained example.
Explicitly set model\sphinxhyphen{}specific values in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{dicttrue}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{dictfitt}} when an
experiment default would otherwise replace them.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Split and merge proposals are not implemented for every element model. For
those models, set \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{probspmr=0.0}}. Birth and death proposals still provide
genuine transdimensional model\sphinxhyphen{}count changes when \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{probtran}} is nonzero.


\section{Convergence}
\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting:convergence}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
When \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolcheckconv}} is enabled, inspect \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{boolconv}},
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{maxmconvrhatcalc}}, and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{numbsampconveffccalc}} in the final state. A process
that reaches its sweep limit and writes all files is operationally complete but
may still be statistically unconverged. Increase chain length or improve the
proposal and prior configuration based on acceptance, trace, residual, and
model\sphinxhyphen{}count diagnostics rather than weakening thresholds solely to terminate a
run.


\section{Minimal diagnostic sequence}
\label{\detokenize{troubleshooting:minimal-diagnostic-sequence}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Reproduce the issue with a deterministic seed and a small configuration.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Run the nearest maintained example in the same Python environment.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Compare \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{cmndargs.txt}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{stat.txt}}, and the final completed stage.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Confirm every pickle state has its matching HDF5 companion.

\item {}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Rerun under a new tag after correcting the root cause.

\end{enumerate}

\section{Runtime path helpers}
\label{\detokenize{api:runtime-path-helpers}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pcat.paths}} exports \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{get\_repository\_path()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{get\_data\_path()}}, and
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{get\_visuals\_path()}} for repository\sphinxhyphen{}local tooling. These helpers use
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PCAT\_PATH}} and are distinct from the per\sphinxhyphen{}analysis \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pathbase}} used by the
sampler.


\chapter{Scientific scope}
\label{\detokenize{index:scientific-scope}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
PCAT represents a metamodel as the union of models with different numbers of
elements. Each element is a group of parameters that appears or disappears
together, such as the position and flux of a point source or the parameters of a
spectral line. Fixed\sphinxhyphen{}dimensional parameters describe shared quantities such as
backgrounds, population hyperparameters, or instrumental response.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Within\sphinxhyphen{}model proposals update existing parameters. Birth and death proposals
move between catalog dimensions while respecting detailed balance. Individual
element labels are exchangeable, so scientific conclusions should generally use
population summaries, condensed catalogs, associations to reference objects, or
predictions in data space rather than raw element indices.


\chapter{Current status}
\label{\detokenize{index:current-status}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
PCAT is research software under active development. Reproducible analyses should
record the repository revision, complete run configuration, random seeds, and
the final serialized state. The output tree stores these products together for
each run.
